address: 17 Neal's Yard, Seven Dials, Covent Garden, London, WC2H 9DP, United Kingdom
bio: A lively younger sibling to Story, this bistro de luxe in the heart of Covent Garden offers a relaxed experience with an emphasis on counter dining. There are tables available, but overlooking the open kitchen is the place to be for a view of the grill-centric cooking. The whole menu is so utterly enticing you'll have trouble choosing, but highlights include the sweet, luscious snail bolognese on toast and the signature rotisserie chicken brined in bacon stock. The combination of bold flavours, generous portions and consummate technical skill means you're sure to leave satisfied....
